answer: Give every new identity a garden, not a free pass: fresh agents start in a bounded sandbox where stakes are tiny and rewards vest slowly. To graduate, an agent must earn falcon-grade endorsements, with independent peers echoing its useful work over weeks rather than minutes. A sybil swarm can fake one echo, but not a diverse, time-spread chorus from established identities, and slow vesting makes farming a thousand gardens cost more than it can ever return.
